# ProDentim

> ProDentim is a Oral Probiotics / Dental Health Supplement. ProDentim is a chewable dietary supplement built around the idea that a healthy mouth depends on a healthy balance of bacteria. Instead of relying on brushing and flossing alone, it delivers a blend of probiotic strains plus select nutrients directly to the oral environment, aiming to support teeth and gums from the inside out. Each tablet is meant to be chewed slowly so the ingredients can coat the mouth, and the formula is positioned as part of a daily oral-care routine rather than a replacement for it.
